def min_schools_to_make_up(n, m, k, powers, schools, chosen_ones):
    # Create a list of tuples (power, school) and sort it by power in descending order
    students = sorted(zip(powers, schools), reverse=True)
    
    # Dictionary to store the strongest student per school
    strongest_per_school = {}
    
    # Initialize the count of schools to be made up
    schools_to_make_up = 0
    
    # Iterate over each Chosen One
    for chosen_one in chosen_ones:
        # Find the student with the highest power in the same school as the Chosen One
        max_power_in_same_school = max(students[i][0] for i in range(n) if students[i][1] == schools[chosen_one - 1])
        
        # If the Chosen One is not the strongest in their school, find out how many new schools are needed
        if powers[chosen_one - 1] < max_power_in_same_school:
            # Determine the number of new schools needed
            new_schools_needed = len(strongest_per_school) + 1
            
            # Update the count of schools to be made up
            schools_to_make_up += new_schools_needed
        
        # Add the Chosen One to the dictionary of strongest students per school
        strongest_per_school[schools[chosen_one - 1]] = powers[chosen_one - 1]
    
    return schools_to_make_up
